summary: Fixed a shared-autotuner semantic gap where config/global pre-hooks and the post-hook ran for benchmark repetitions but were skipped by the selected user-visible execution, including searched-winner cache hits. The selected call now applies the same reset, hook ordering, compile hints, and kernel execution semantics as the measured calls. A failing-before/passing-after regression covers the initial selected call and a normal cache hit. The existing accepted-artifact failure and invalid-artifact fallback contracts remain covered.

tests.what_was_measured: Reproduced the defect: the selected final call skipped setup hooks and produced 1.0 instead of the benchmarked program's expected 13.0. Raw output: /job/evidence/failing-before-hooks.txt
Verified config pre-hook, global pre-hook, kernel, and post-hook ordering on the post-search execution and a non-searching winner-cache hit. Raw output: /job/evidence/passing-after-hooks.txt

56 shared-autotuner unit tests passed, covering explicit opt-in ordering, cache identity, state restoration/reset, declared keys, artifact validation/fallback, and loud accepted-artifact runtime failure. Raw output: /job/evidence/unit-autotune-after.txt

Seven artifact-policy cases passed: accepted runtime failure propagated without default retry, while corrupt/version/identity/config/override/type-invalid artifacts fell back. Raw output: /job/evidence/artifact-contract-after.txt

52 tests passed on AMD Instinct MI355X/gfx950, including independent Torch numerical references, explicit no-search serving for Softmax and RMSNorm, hot compiled-cache reuse, declared tuning axes, and 256/512-thread compiler specialization. Raw output: /job/evidence/gpu-supported-kernels.txt

tests.command: FLYDSL_AUTOTUNE=0 python <inline Softmax numerical/cache/IR evidence script>
tests.what_was_measured: Two normal bf16 Softmax calls had max absolute error 2.8591603e-05 and max scaled error 0.00189361582 versus torch.softmax; outputs were identical and resolve_config ran once. Compiler output contained known_block_size=512 and ISA metadata max_flat_workgroup_size=512. Raw output: /job/evidence/softmax-numerical-isa.txt

remaining_limitations: The defect and fix are in Python orchestration only; no FlyDSL C++ or LLVM source changed, so the prepared native rebuild was not applicable. GPU execution was verified on the assigned AMD Instinct MI355X/gfx950 (unique ID 0xc1a597582efe51ae) only. Raw evidence is retained under /job/evidence, including gpu-info.txt and softmax-numerical-isa.txt; tested Python source is /job/repo/python/flydsl/autotune.py and the unchanged pinned native module is /opt/venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages/flydsl/_mlir.
